collection.title: Dacia Duster 2016 to 2018 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Dacia Duster 2016 - 2018 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" for the passengers side. This model uses the Specific Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
